decisions.reason: The title omits nonempty boundary. Under the actual F1 definition, a small interior sphere has no essential circle and no boundary-compressing arc, and cannot cobound a product with a sphere subsurface of the boundary torus. It is therefore essential but is not a meridian disk. The Statement already expressly requires nonempty boundary, so this is a title defect rather than a false classification theorem. Added the missing qualifier to the item title and its owning manifest mirror; the Statement and proof remain unchanged.

This records my adjudication and title repair, not an independent review of my own edit.
